title: MC Product-Studio Contract — Decision Record (v0.1)
description: The oneshot stand-in for α/β judgment: a decision emitted by an ENFORCER without a human present, embedded in artifact metadata and read by the arbitration-needed resolver. Shape-compatible with betaEvents (shares decision/owner/rationale/confidence) but a DISTINCT schema/file — NOT the betaEvents file (β EVT-sp20260530-001-before-plan-beta-001: preserves the oneshot clean-room invariant — enforcers must not import the α/β machinery to emit a record). Not a chain artifact (precedence: null).
precedence_note: decision_record is not part of the derivation chain; precedence is null and it is excluded from the chain's distinct-precedence check.

decision.description: What was decided (field name shared with betaEvents for shape-compatibility).

owner.description: Which enforcer/domain made the call (shared with betaEvents).

precedence_basis.description: Which contract precedence resolved the conflict (the oneshot-specific field betaEvents lacks).

arbitration_needed.description: TRUE = fail-closed: contracts conflicted or confidence was low; a human/β must arbitrate (the oneshot stand-in for α/β escalation).
